message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of an iterative curriculum–executor training loop with tool interaction and response filtering.","description":"Two horizontal stages show a Curriculum Agent generating tasks for an Executor Agent. In the upper stage, the executor produces multiple responses, may call a tool through an environment, and uses majority voting to form answer labels; a GRPO policy update feeds back to the curriculum agent. In the lower stage, generated data is filtered by self-consistency, with an ambiguity signal, before the executor is trained using ADPO and majority-vote labels. Cartoon agent figures, task and response boxes, arrows, and a legend distinguish model responses, tool calls, tool responses, and final answers.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
